nom: DRMTLGY Needle-less Plumping and Smoothing Serum

segments.combination: The one reviewer who identifies combination skin says only a small amount, a few drops, is needed to fully hydrate her face and neck.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several managing rosacea, seborrheic dermatitis, or acne-prone reactivity, consistently report the serum does not irritate them, with some saying it is one of very few products that doesn't cause a reaction or breakout.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention their age, mostly in their late 40s to 70s, overwhelmingly report smoother, plumper, more lifted-looking skin, several saying they are mistaken for years younger; the one dissent comes from a 51-year-old who, after a year of use, sees no visible improvement in her existing wrinkles, though she also notes none have gotten worse.

concerns.aging: The overwhelming majority of reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, wrinkles, or nasolabial and lip lines, often within two to four weeks, with several saying they now skip Botox or are mistaken for years younger; the one clear dissent comes from a reviewer who saw no improvement in her wrinkles after a full year, though she notes they also did not worsen.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the serum as hydrating and plumping, absorbing quickly without feeling sticky, oily, or heavy, and several specifically note it does not over-dry despite daily use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who previously had a bad reaction to hyaluronic acid reports no side effects at all with this gentle formula; reviewers managing rosacea or dermatitis conditions similarly report it does not aggravate their skin.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report a more even skin tone with continued use, and one describes a long-standing sun spot fading completely, with some peeling and pinkness, after finishing her first bottle of once-daily use; another is hopeful but has not yet confirmed a change in her dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin report the serum does not cause breakouts, unlike other products they have tried, though one credits her acne improvement to a broader combination of product and diet changes rather than this serum alone.

aspects.libelle: Dropper or cap can break, wasting product
A little goes a long way
Layers well under moisturizer and makeup without pilling
Premium price, but seen as worth the splurge

extraits.texte: I have looked at and purchased more products than I can name. Also returned them. I took a chance on this one. It feels very soothing when I apply this serum. At first it feels like oil until you feel it moisturizing your skin. It's not sticky or oily. I like the way the serum makes my skin look and feel. I'm noticing my neck look less wrinkly. I like this product and how it works for me.

Im 73. I had an almost dime size sun spot on my forehead..had it for years. I've tried many things to at least fade it. I tried needless serum just in am. Very slowly it start fading.It would peel get a little pink but at the end of 1st bottle once a day, its gone..and during the hot summer! It tightness my skin and has helped with fine lines... deep wrinkles wont ever go away unless i get a face lift. My skin feels smoother to the touch. Im a reddish head with freckles and out in the sun alot. I do make sure to put xtra physical ss over areas i am trying to fade. I use the serum on my face neck and decolletage. Got a complement on my skin ..i was barefaced, from a younger woman the other day. Its great stuff! I reccomended the Needlesss serum to her and anyone else with sunspots n and generally tigter smoother skin.

extraits.titre: Needle-less Serum is my favourite product!
extraits.texte: I love the Needle-less Serum. I've been taking care of my skin since I was 20, but I'll be turning 60 in a few weeks. I use it twice a day, and I have noticed the lines have significantly softened or disappeared on my forehead, upper lip and around my eyes! This Serum is a water-like consistency, and 4 drops covers my face and neck. It sinks in quickly and makes my skin feel amazing. My moisturiser (I use the Water Creme in the am and the Peptide Night Cream at night) glides on, and I only need a small amount to completely hydrate my combination skin. I feel my skin looks better now than 20 years ago! I'll never be without it.

I started using this just to help smooth my complexion and help with the start of wrinkles. It definitely made my skin have more of a glow and smooth texture. Also, I was diagnosed with rosacea, seborrheic dermatitis, and perineal dermatitis. So super sensitive skin! This serum did not affect it at all for me. I have this on auto ship and have for a long time now. It is a necessity!

extraits.titre: Want to be a believer of this serum
extraits.texte: Everyone says is great. I'm 51 years old and I have wrinkles. I've been using it for a year now at least and I don't see a difference, but I also don't seem to have more wrinkles than the ones I already have, so that is also good! I'm going to keep using it. Thank you 💗

I had a bad reaction to hyaluronic acid a couple years ago, so I was hesitant about trying this product. No side effects with this gentle formula! Coats the skin with a silky feel that absorbs quicky under my peptide night cream.
I finally found an anti-aging serum the works. After two weeks I am noticing smoother skin and a healthy glow. Bonus is it didn't make me breakout like other serums have.
